module: Editor "Traffic Gated Roads" (Traffic menu): places spheres (displayed as vertical cylinders 20 m high, adjustable radius) in the world and saves them to a JSON file, by default /gameplay/trafficGatedRoads.json. Each sphere has id, name, pos {x,y,z}, quat {x,y,z,w} and radius (10 by default). Ctrl+click adds a sphere, Shift+click duplicates the selection, click selects, Del deletes; a gizmo moves, rotates or scales. The role of this data in traffic is not defined in this file.
notes: The SAVE button and the Save menu are disabled as long as the path is the default one: you must go through Save As.
Moving with "Snap to Terrain" fires a static raycast downward from 50 m above the point.
The state (data, filePath, selection, nextId) is kept across a Lua reload via onSerialize / onDeserialized.
Leaving the window switches the editor back to objectSelect mode; regaining focus re-enables the edit mode.
M.allowGizmo returns false (not nil) outside the edit mode, whereas the local function of the same name may return nil.

allowGizmo.desc: True when the current edit mode is "Edit Traffic Gated Roads": the gizmo is then allowed.

loadData.desc: Loads a JSON file of spheres (jsonReadFile). On failure, logs an error and changes nothing. Otherwise replaces the data, remembers the path, clears the selection and recomputes nextId.

fp.desc: File path; no effect if nil.

saveData.desc: Writes the data to a JSON file (jsonWriteFile, human-readable formatting) and remembers the path.

fp.desc: Path; defaults to the current path.

show.desc: Clears the object selection, shows the window and switches to the trafficGatedRoadsEditMode edit mode.

onEditorInitialized.desc: Editor hook: creates the trafficGatedRoadsEditMode edit mode (left click = Select), registers the window (400x500) and the Traffic menu entry.

onEditorGui.desc: Hook called every interface frame: draws the window (File menu, SAVE, sphere list, name, position, radius, Snap to Terrain checkbox), handles the mouse, draws the cylinders with debugDrawer:drawCylinder and the gizmo (move, rotate, scale).

onEditorToolWindowHide.desc: Hook called when a tool window is hidden: if it is this one, returns to objectSelect mode.

onWindowGotFocus.desc: Hook called when a window gains focus: if it is this one, re-enables the edit mode.

onSerialize.desc: Hook called before a Lua reload: returns the state to keep.

onDeserialized.desc: Hook called after a Lua reload: restores the state returned by onSerialize.
